projects.name: Analytics Dashboard
projects.description:
A customer analytics dashboard that ingests customer CSV files, analyzes application logs, and presents insights through interactive visualization components. Scope covers three major workstreams plus integration: (1) a data processing pipeline for customer CSV ingestion/validation/transformation, (2) an application log analysis layer for parsing, aggregating, and anomaly detection, (3) a reusable visualization component library and dashboard layout, and (4) end-to-end integration, testing, and deployment. Work is broken into small, individually executable tasks to minimize execution complexity and risk.

Tags: analytics, dashboard, data-pipeline, log-analysis, visualization

tasks.name: M1 — Foundation: Requirements, Data Contracts & Scaffolding
tasks.details: Milestone container. Lock down what the dashboard must show, pick the stack, and define the data contracts that the CSV pipeline, log analysis layer, and visualization layer will all share. Everything downstream depends on the schemas agreed here, so this milestone must finish before M2/M3/M4 start in earnest. Decomposed into 5 small subtasks; no single subtask should require more than one focused work session.

tasks.name: M2 — Customer CSV Data Processing Pipeline
tasks.details: Milestone container. Build the ingestion path for customer CSV files: discover/read files, validate against the schema contract from M1, clean and normalize records, compute customer metrics (retention, cohorts, LTV), and persist results for the dashboard to consume. Includes a focused test suite. Decomposed into 6 subtasks, each independently shippable and testable.

tasks.name: M3 — Application Log Analysis
tasks.details: Milestone container. Build the log analysis layer: parse application log files, normalize fields (timestamp, level, service, request ID), aggregate errors and request metrics, and detect anomalies/spikes. Output must conform to the schema defined in M1 so the dashboard can join log metrics with customer metrics. Decomposed into 5 subtasks.

tasks.name: M4 — Visualization Components & Dashboard UI
tasks.details: Milestone container. Design and build the presentation layer: dashboard layout, a reusable charting foundation, KPI cards, time-series charts, and filterable tables, then assemble the pages against mock data so integration in M5 is mostly wiring. Decomposed into 6 subtasks.

tasks.name: M5 — Integration, Testing & Deployment
tasks.details: Milestone container. Wire the real pipeline and log outputs into the dashboard, run end-to-end and performance tests, fix accessibility/responsiveness gaps, automate deployment, and hand over documentation. Depends on M2, M3, and M4 all being complete. Decomposed into 5 subtasks.

tasks.name: Define dashboard requirements, user stories & success metrics
tasks.details: Document who uses the dashboard and what decisions it supports. Produce a short requirements doc with 5-8 user stories (e.g. "as an ops lead I can see error rate by service over the last 24h"), the key questions each dashboard page must answer, and success metrics (freshness, load time, accuracy). Output: docs/requirements.md. Deliberately scoped to one session — no implementation.

tasks.name: Select tech stack and scaffold repository structure
tasks.details: Choose frontend framework, charting library, data processing language/runtime, and storage layer, recording the rationale and rejected alternatives in docs/adr/001-stack.md. Then create the repo skeleton: /pipeline (csv + logs), /web (dashboard), /shared (schemas/types), /tests, and config files. Include a README with setup commands. Stop at skeleton + a single "hello world" run per package; no real logic.

tasks.name: Define customer CSV schema contract & sample fixtures
tasks.details: Specify the customer CSV contract in /shared/schema/customer.*: required vs optional columns, types, formats (date, currency, country codes), allowed nulls, and validation rules. Include a versioned schema id so the pipeline can reject incompatible files. Create 3-4 anonymized sample fixtures covering happy path, missing optional fields, and malformed rows. Deliverable: schema file + fixtures + a short README section.

tasks.name: Define log event schema and metrics contract
tasks.details: Specify the normalized log event shape (timestamp, level, service, request_id, latency_ms, status_code, message, error_code) plus the aggregate metric shapes the dashboard will consume (error rate per service per minute, p50/p95/p99 latency, top error codes). Document how unparsable lines are handled. Create shared type definitions and a JSON example. Keep to schema/type work only — parsing logic belongs to M3.

tasks.name: Set up CI, linting, formatting and test harness
tasks.details: Add a CI workflow that runs lint, format check, type check and unit tests on every push/PR for both pipeline and web packages. Configure formatter and linter with shared rules, add test runners with coverage reporting, and ensure one trivial passing test exists per package so CI is green from day one. Keep it minimal and fast (<5 min pipeline).

tasks.name: Build CSV file discovery and chunked reader
tasks.details: Implement a reader that scans a configured input directory for customer CSVs, handles encodings (UTF-8 + BOM) and delimiter detection, and streams records in bounded chunks so large files don't exhaust memory. Emit raw dict rows plus source filename/line number for traceability. No validation or transformation in this task. Deliverable: reader module + a CLI flag to dump the first N raw rows.

tasks.name: Implement schema validation with row-level error reporting
tasks.details: Validate each row against the customer schema contract: required columns present, types coercible, formats valid, schema version compatible. Collect per-row errors (not fail-fast) into a structured error report with file, line, field, and reason, and route bad rows to a rejects file. Exit code should distinguish "no data" from "all rows rejected". Deliverable: validator module + error report format + tests for each rule.

tasks.name: Implement cleaning, normalization and dedupe
tasks.details: Transform validated rows into the canonical customer record: trim whitespace, normalize country/currency codes and casing, parse dates to ISO-8601 UTC, coerce numeric types, apply documented null-defaults, and de-duplicate on customer_id keeping the most recent record (log which duplicates were dropped). Keep transformations pure functions so they are easy to unit test. Deliverable: transform module + tests for each rule.

tasks.name: Implement idempotent customer record writer
tasks.details: Write cleaned customer records to the storage layer chosen in M1 (Parquet/DB table) with upserts keyed by customer_id so re-running the same input never duplicates rows. Include schema migration for the customers table and an integration test against a temp store proving idempotency. Run tracking and the query helper are a separate follow-on task.

tasks.name: Compute retention and cohort aggregates
tasks.details: From cleaned customer data, compute signup cohorts by month/week, active-vs-churned counts per cohort period, and retention/drop-off rates. Write results to the aggregates store in the shape defined in the shared contract. Validate against one hand-calculated fixture example. Keep to cohort/retention only — revenue metrics are a separate task.

tasks.name: Compute LTV and revenue aggregates
tasks.details: Compute per-customer total spend, order frequency, average order value, and a simple historical LTV plus monthly revenue rollups by segment/plan. Document the LTV formula in code comments and the metrics doc. Validate outputs against one hand-calculated fixture example. Depends on cleaned customer data only.

tasks.name: Write pipeline test suite against sample fixtures
tasks.details: Add unit tests for reader/validator/transform functions and one end-to-end test that runs the full pipeline over the M1 fixtures and asserts row counts, rejects, dedupe behavior, and aggregate values. Include a golden-file test for the error report format. Target meaningful coverage of branch logic (happy path, malformed rows, empty file, duplicate ids).

tasks.name: Build log line parser with pluggable format support
tasks.details: Implement a parser that reads application log files line-by-line (streaming, gzip-aware) and converts them to raw structured events. Support at least JSON-lines and one common plain-text pattern, selected by a format config. Include a format-detection helper and a CLI that prints the first N parsed events. No metric aggregation yet. Deliverable: parser module + format config + sample-lines test.

tasks.name: Normalize log fields and quarantine unparsable lines
tasks.details: Map raw parsed events into the canonical log event schema: parse timestamps to ISO-8601 UTC (handle multiple formats/timezones), normalize level aliases (WARN/warning, ERR/error), extract service name, request id, status code, latency, and error code. Lines that cannot be parsed are counted and written to a quarantine file with the reason rather than crashing the run. Deliverable: normalizer + quarantine report + tests.

tasks.name: Aggregate error rates and latency percentiles per service
tasks.details: Compute the metric shapes defined in the M1 contract: request counts and error counts per service per minute, error rate, and p50/p95/p99 latency (document the percentile method used), plus top-N error codes and messages per service. Handle sparse buckets explicitly (zero-fill vs omit) and write results to the aggregates store. Deliverable: aggregation module + output matching the contract example.

tasks.name: Implement error-spike and anomaly detection
tasks.details: Add a lightweight detector over the per-minute error-rate series: compare each bucket to a rolling baseline (e.g. mean + k·stddev over prior window) and flag sustained spikes with start time, service, severity, and observed vs expected rate. Make thresholds configurable and avoid alert storms by merging adjacent buckets into one incident. Deliverable: detector module + example output on a seeded spike fixture.

tasks.name: Write log analysis test suite with log fixtures
tasks.details: Create log fixtures (JSON-lines, plain text, malformed lines, gzip, a seeded error spike) and tests for parser, normalizer, aggregator, and detector. Assert exact counts/percentiles on a small hand-verifiable fixture and assert the detector fires once on the seeded spike and stays quiet on a flat series. Include a perf smoke test on a ~100k-line generated file.

tasks.name: Design dashboard layout, wireframes and design tokens
tasks.details: Produce low-fidelity wireframes for each dashboard page (customer overview, retention/cohorts, revenue, log health) with a responsive grid definition (desktop/tablet/mobile). Define design tokens: color palette (including accessible chart series colors), spacing scale, typography, and chart axis/grid conventions. Output: docs/wireframes + tokens file. No component code.

tasks.name: Build charting foundation: theme, base wrapper and states
tasks.details: Integrate the chosen charting library and create a BaseChart wrapper that applies design tokens, responsive sizing, consistent tooltips/legends/axes, and handles loading, empty, and error states. Wrap it with a small typed API (data, series config, formatters) so individual chart tasks cannot diverge in style. Deliverable: BaseChart + theme + Storybook/demo page showing the three states.

tasks.name: Build KPI card components with delta indicators
tasks.details: Create a reusable KPI/stat card supporting label, primary value, unit formatting (count, currency, percent), period-over-period delta with up/down/neutral styling, optional sparkline slot, and loading/skeleton state. Add a small grid container for responsive KPI rows. Deliverable: KpiCard + KpiRow + component tests + demo entries.

tasks.name: Build time-series chart components
tasks.details: On top of BaseChart, implement three time-series components: (1) line/area chart for error rate over time, (2) line chart for latency p50/p95/p99, (3) stacked bar for requests by service. Each accepts typed data from the shared contract and supports an optional threshold/annotation line for anomaly spikes. Deliverable: three components + demo entries + tests for data-to-series mapping. Cohort heatmap and revenue trend are a separate task.

tasks.name: Build filterable, sortable data table component
tasks.details: Create a table component with column sorting, text search, multi-select facet filters (service, segment, status), pagination, numeric/date formatting, and empty/loading states. Make filters emit a typed filter object the page can pass to the data layer later. Keep virtualization optional but documented for large result sets. Deliverable: DataTable + filter controls + tests.

tasks.name: Assemble dashboard pages with mock data
tasks.details: Compose the built components into the four pages from the wireframes (customer overview, retention/cohorts, revenue, log health) wired to typed mock datasets that mirror the shared contracts. Add the page shell with global date-range and service filters, URL-synced filter state, and loading/empty/error handling on every panel. Deliverable: four routable pages running on mock data + a click-through demo. No real data wiring (that is M5).

tasks.name: Build dashboard data access layer over pipeline outputs
tasks.details: Expose the customer, retention, revenue, and log aggregates to the frontend through a thin typed data layer (REST endpoints or build-time static export, per the M1 ADR). Implement the filter parameters the UI already emits (date range, service, segment), add caching for expensive aggregates, and return consistent error shapes. Deliverable: data layer + contract tests proving each endpoint matches the shared types.

tasks.name: Wire dashboard pages to the live data layer
tasks.details: Replace every page's mock fixtures with calls to the real data access layer (customer, retention, revenue, log metrics). Map API responses into component props, keep the typed filter object flowing from UI to query, and surface real loading/error/empty states. Deliverable: all four pages rendering live aggregates. Browser-level E2E coverage is a separate follow-on task.

tasks.name: Benchmark pipeline and dashboard performance
tasks.details: Build a benchmark harness and capture baseline numbers: pipeline throughput (rows/sec, peak memory) on a realistic dataset, and dashboard initial load plus filter response times against the M1 success metrics. Record results in docs/performance.md. Do not fix anything in this task — only measure and rank bottlenecks.

tasks.name: Accessibility and responsive QA pass with fixes
tasks.details: Audit all four pages at mobile/tablet/desktop widths and with keyboard-only navigation plus a screen reader smoke check. Fix: color-contrast issues in charts and KPI deltas, missing chart text alternatives/data tables, focus order in filters and tables, and layout overflow at narrow widths. Add automated axe checks to the component test suite. Deliverable: audit checklist + fixes + passing axe run.

tasks.name: Automate CI/CD deployment with rollback gate
tasks.details: Add a CI/CD workflow that builds, tests and deploys the dashboard plus publishes pipeline artifacts, with a manual approval gate for production and a documented one-step rollback. Include smoke checks after deploy and environment config handling. Documentation is a separate task.

tasks.name: Add processing-run tracking and query helper
tasks.details: Add a processing_run table/record capturing run id, source files, rows read/accepted/rejected, duration, and status for each pipeline execution. Add a small typed query helper (e.g. getCustomers(filters), getRunHistory()) that the data access layer in M5 will call. Deliverable: run-tracking module + query helper + tests. Single concern: observability and read access to the customer store.

tasks.name: Build cohort heatmap and revenue trend chart
tasks.details: On top of BaseChart, implement two customer-analytics components: (1) cohort retention heatmap from the retention aggregates (cohort rows × period columns, accessible color scale + values), and (2) revenue trend chart (monthly revenue with optional segment breakdown). Both take typed data from the shared contract. Deliverable: two components + demo entries + mapping tests.

tasks.name: Add end-to-end browser tests for the dashboard
tasks.details: Add browser-level E2E tests over seeded pipeline output: pages load with real aggregates, filters change the visible numbers, empty datasets show empty states, and a seeded error spike appears on the log health page. Assert displayed KPI values equal the pipeline's computed aggregates. Deliverable: E2E suite runnable with one command in CI.

tasks.name: Write operations and handoff documentation
tasks.details: Write docs/README covering: architecture overview, how to run the pipeline on new CSV/log inputs, how to add a new chart, data contract reference, troubleshooting, and known limitations. Include a short onboarding checklist so a new engineer can operate the system alone. Keep it to documentation only.

tasks.name: Optimize the top identified bottlenecks
tasks.details: Using the benchmark report, fix only the highest-impact items (e.g. query indexes, pre-aggregation, payload trimming, chart render memoization). Re-run the harness and record before/after numbers in docs/performance.md. Stop when the M1 success metrics are met.
